# Variable INPUTS

```{r}
# name of folder where this Rmd file is saved
myfolder <- "osm-data-query-from-geom"

# name of file describing study area boundaries
myfile <- "buenos-aires-boundary.geojson"

# name of the study area (no spaces)
studyarea <- "buenos-aires"
```

# Read study area

```{r}
# read study area file
sa <- st_read(paste0("input/", myfile))

# extract only polygon
sa %>%
  st_collection_extract(., type = c("POLYGON")) -> sa
```

# Get OSM data for study area

```{r}
# check/create Output directory
mainDir <- getwd()
subDir <- paste0(studyarea,"-osm-data")

if (file.exists(subDir)){
    setwd(file.path(mainDir))
} else {
    dir.create(file.path(mainDir, subDir))
    setwd(file.path(mainDir))
}

# get data
# Download the data to osm-data folder. 
oe_get(sa, download_directory = subDir, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, extra_tags = c("water","railway"), download_only = TRUE, skip_vectortranslate = TRUE)

# study area spatial
# data for study area
pbf <- list.files(path = file.path(mainDir, subDir), pattern = "*.pbf")
dir <- file.path(mainDir, subDir, pbf)

# polygon geometries for study area
oe_read(dir, layer = "multipolygons", extra_tags = "water") -> pols_city

# study area buffer for border areas not covered by hexagons
sa -> saboundary

# create bigger study area if no level 6 hexagon has center contained in a given polygon
if (is.na(polyfill(saboundary, res = 6)[1])){
  st_buffer(saboundary, 6000) -> saboundaryB
}

# pick one level 6 hexagon in study area
h3_to_geo_boundary_sf(polyfill(saboundaryB, res = 6)[1]) %>%
  # projected coordinates
  st_transform(3857) -> hex6tor
# find the radius of a circle that circumscribes a polygon
max(st_distance(st_cast(hex6tor,"POINT"), st_centroid(hex6tor))) -> bufcir # 5934m ~ radius of circle

saboundary %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3857) %>%
  st_buffer(bufcir)-> sabox

# create hex 6 grid
# get all hexagons level 6 with centers contained in study area
h3_indexes <- polyfill(sabox, res = 6)
# make study area hex ids data frame
sahid <- data.frame(h3_index = h3_indexes)

# export as csv
write_csv(sahid, file = paste0(mainDir,"/",studyarea,"-all-h3_indexes.csv"))
```

# Create hex grid from hexid

```{r}
# get hex polygon geometries with centres contained in a given polygon at res = 12
hexid12 <- polyfill(saboundary, res = 12)
# get res = 12 polygons
hexpol12 <- h3_to_geo_boundary_sf(hexid12) %>%
  # add hexid column
  mutate(h3_index = hexid12)

# create df of hex12 polygons id
hexpol12 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() -> hexid12

# create parent-child correspondence table level 6-12

pdf <- c()
getpid <- function(i){
  
  h3_to_parent(i, 6) -> pdf
  
}

lapply(hexid12$h3_index, getpid) -> pcdfl

do.call(rbind, pcdfl) %>%
  as.data.frame() -> pcdf

hexid12 %>%
  mutate(parenthexidlv6 = pcdf$V1) -> hexid12f
```

# Read pbf file by layer types

```{r}
# data for study area
# lines geometries
oe_read(dir, layer = "lines", extra_tags = "railway") -> lines_city

# data for study area boundary
# polygon geometries
oe_read(dir, layer = "multipolygons", extra_tags = "water", boundary = saboundary, boundary_type = "spat") -> pols
# lines geometries
oe_read(dir, layer = "lines", extra_tags = "railway", boundary = saboundary, boundary_type = "spat") -> lines
```

# Create OSM city data statistics

## City data keys above threshold

```{r}
# calculate osm city stats by key and get values > 0.05% count
values005 <- function(value, df) {
  
  df %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select({{value}}) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.)) %>%
    group_by({{value}}) %>%
    summarise(n = n()) %>%
    # percentage
    mutate(pc = 100* (n / sum(n))) %>%
    filter(pc > 0.05) %>%
    pull({{value}}) -> values
  
  return(values)
}

#values005(railway, lines)
```

# Create OSM data statistics

## Split into relevant layers

```{r}
# function to create list of valid POLYGON objects according to relevant layers
# define dataframe
df <- pols
# define keys
keys <- c("natural", "water", "building", "landuse")

polslist <- list()
for (i in keys) {
  df %>%
    # collapse ids to create a unique id label
    mutate(osm_nid = case_when(is.na(osm_id) ~ osm_way_id,
                             TRUE ~ osm_id)) %>%
    # select key and keep osm id
    select(i, osm_nid) %>%
    # drop NAs
    drop_na(.) %>%
    # make valid polygons (repair those with self-intersection?)
    st_make_valid() -> valf
  
  # id of remaining invalid geometries
  which(st_is_valid(valf, reason = TRUE) != "Valid Geometry") -> invalid
  
  # ghost integer to ease slice
  c(invalid, 999999) -> invalid
  
  valf %>%
    # remove invalid geometries
    slice(-invalid) %>%
    # calculate area (remove units and round to 1 digit)
    mutate(osmf_dim = round(as.numeric(st_area(.)),1)) -> valf
  
  # get only the non-empty geometries
  valf[!st_is_empty(valf), , drop=FALSE] -> valf
  
  # reclassify by threshold criteria 
  valf %>%
    mutate(!!sym(i) := case_when(!!sym(i) %in% values005(!!sym(i), pols_city) ~ !!sym(i),
                         TRUE ~ "other")) -> polslist[[i]]
}

# function to create list of valid LINE objects according to relevant layers
# define dataframe
df <- lines
# define keys
keys <- c("waterway", "railway", "highway")

lineslist <- list()
for (i in keys) {
  df %>%
    # collapse ids to create a unique id label: lines don't have 'osm_way_id'
    mutate(osm_nid = osm_id) %>%
    # select key and keep osm id
    select(i, osm_nid) %>%
    # drop NAs
    drop_na(.) %>%
    # make valid lines
    st_make_valid() -> valf
  
  # id of remaining invalid geometries
  which(st_is_valid(valf, reason = TRUE) != "Valid Geometry") -> invalid
  
  # ghost integer to ease slice
  c(invalid, 999999) -> invalid
  
  valf %>%
    # remove invalid geometries
    slice(-invalid) %>%
    # calculate length (remove units and round to 1 digit)
    mutate(osmf_dim = round(as.numeric(st_length(.)),1)) -> valf
  
  # get only the non-empty geometries
  valf[!st_is_empty(valf), , drop=FALSE] -> valf
  
  # reclassify by threshold criteria 
  valf %>%
    mutate(!!sym(i) := case_when(!!sym(i) %in% values005(!!sym(i), lines_city) ~ !!sym(i),
                         TRUE ~ "other")) -> lineslist[[i]]
}
```

## Study area statistics by key

# Create statistics by hexagon

```{r}
# set precision
# use crs=3857 to speed up intersection
hexpol12 %>%
  st_transform(crs=3857) %>%
  st_set_precision(units::set_units(10, nm)) -> hexpol12

# function that prepares geometry and intersects with hexpol
hexintersect <- function(geoms) {
  geoms %>%
    st_transform(crs=3857) %>%
    st_set_precision(units::set_units(10, nm)) %>%
    st_make_valid() -> geoms
  
  st_intersection(hexpol12, geoms) -> geoms
}

# apply function to all elements in POLYGON list
lapply(polslist, hexintersect) -> polslisthex

# apply function to all elements in LINES list
lapply(lineslist, hexintersect) -> lineslisthex
```

```{r}
osmtable <- function(key) {
  # create summary table of osm_ids by hexagon
  key %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(h3_index, osm_nid) %>%
    group_by(h3_index) %>%
    mutate(osm_nm = paste0("osm_nid_", row_number(), sep = "")) %>%
    # osm ids of values as variables
    pivot_wider(names_from = osm_nm, values_from = osm_nid) -> onid
  
  # create summary table of osm feature dimensions by hexagon
  key %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(h3_index, osmf_dim) %>%
    group_by(h3_index) %>%
    mutate(osm_nm = paste0("osm_", "dim_", row_number(), sep = "")) %>%
    # osm areas of values as variables
    pivot_wider(names_from = osm_nm, values_from = osmf_dim) -> dimension
  
  # create summary table of osm features values by hexagon
  key %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(h3_index, 2) %>%
    group_by(h3_index) %>%
    mutate(osm_nm = paste0("osm_", "value_", row_number(), sep = "")) %>%
    # osm features values as variables
    pivot_wider(names_from = osm_nm, values_from = 2) -> value
  
  # join tables
  onid %>%
    left_join(dimension, by = "h3_index") %>%
    left_join(value, by = "h3_index") %>%
    select(h3_index, ends_with(paste0("_", as.character(1:500)))) -> key
}

# apply function to all elements in POLYGON list
lapply(polslisthex, osmtable) -> polsosmtable

# apply function to all elements in LINES list
lapply(lineslisthex, osmtable) -> linesosmtable
```

## Create statistics by hexagon

```{r}
# POLYGONS
hexstatspol <- function(key) {
  
  # for each element on the list
  key %>%
    # transfrom CRS 3857 -> 4326
    st_transform(4326) %>%
    # calculate hexagons clipped area
    mutate(hc_area = round(as.numeric(st_area(.)),1)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    select(h3_index, 2, hc_area) %>%
    # areas of values as variables (areas of equal value are aggregated with 'values_fn = sum')
    pivot_wider(names_from = 2, values_from = "hc_area", values_fn = sum, values_fill = 0) %>%
    # add prefix to columns 2 onwards
    rename_with( ~ paste0(colnames(key)[2], "_", .x), .cols = 2:ncol(.)) %>%
    mutate_all( ~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
    # add total area adding equal value columns
    mutate(total_dim = rowSums(select(., starts_with(colnames(key)[2]))),
           # diversity = number of columns where area > 0
           diversity = rowSums(select(., starts_with(colnames(key)[2])) != 0)) -> key
  
  # column name pattern
  substr(colnames(key)[2], 1, 3) -> pat
  
  # join statistics to hexagons
  hexpol12 %>%
    left_join(key, by="h3_index") %>%
    # get parent hex6 id
    left_join(hexid12f, by="h3_index") %>%
    # transfrom CRS 3857 -> 4326
    st_transform(4326) %>%
    # calculate hexagons area
    mutate(hex_area = round(as.numeric(st_area(.)),1)) %>%
    # add percentage by column
    mutate(across(starts_with(pat), ~ round(./(hex_area * 0.01),1), .names = '{col}_pc')) -> key
  
}

# apply function to all elements in POLYGON list
lapply(polslisthex, hexstatspol) -> polstats


# LINES
hexstatsline <- function(key) {
  
  # for each element on the list
  key %>%
    # transfrom CRS 3857 -> 4326
    st_transform(4326) %>%
    # calculate hexagons clipped area
    mutate(hc_len = round(as.numeric(st_length(.)),1)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    select(h3_index, 2, hc_len) %>%
    # areas of values as variables (areas of equal value are aggregated with 'values_fn = sum')
    pivot_wider(names_from = 2, values_from = "hc_len", values_fn = sum, values_fill = 0) %>%
    # add prefix to columns 2 onwards
    rename_with( ~ paste0(colnames(key)[2], "_", .x), .cols = 2:ncol(.)) %>%
    mutate_all( ~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
    # add total area adding equal value columns
    mutate(total_dim = rowSums(select(., starts_with(colnames(key)[2]))),
           # diversity = number of columns where area > 0
           diversity = rowSums(select(., starts_with(colnames(key)[2])) != 0)) -> key
  
  # join statistics to hexagons
  hexpol12 %>%
    left_join(key, by="h3_index") %>%
    # get parent hex6 id
    left_join(hexid12f, by="h3_index") %>%
    # transfrom CRS 3857 -> 4326
    st_transform(4326) -> key
}

# apply function to all elements in LINES list
lapply(lineslisthex, hexstatsline) -> linestats
```

# Codebooks

```{r}
data.frame(variable_name = c(
  "WKT",
  "h3_index",
  "natural_water",
  "total_dim",
  "diversity",
  "parenthexidlv6",
  "hex_area",
  "natural_water_pc"),
  variable_description = c(
    "Well-known text representing vector geometry objects",
    "Unique hexagon identifier according to H3 indexing",
    "{key_value} aggregated dimensions (area or length), key is the 'layer' and value is one of the 'classes'",
    "Sum of all values' dimensions (area or length) in square meters or meters",
    "Sum of different values in hexagon",
    "Parent hexagon level 6 indentifier",
    "Total H3 hexagon area of resolution 12 in square meters for polygonal OSM features",
    "{key_value} percentage, proportion of the 'value' area from 'hex_area' for linear OSM features"
  )) -> cbook_hexstats

data.frame(variable_name = c(
  "h3_index",
  "osm_nid_1",
  "osm_dim_1",
  "osm_value_1"),
  variable_description = c(
    "Unique haxagon identifier according to H3 indexing",
    "{osm_nid_X}, OSM unique id, 'X' is a correlative of OSM feature(s). 'nid' is the merge of 'osm_id' and 'osm_way_id'",
    "{osm_dim_X} is the dimension (area or length) of the corresponding 'X' OSM feature(s) in square meters or meters",
    "{osm_value_X} is the 'value' of the corresponding 'X' OSM feature(s)"
    )) -> cbook_osm_legacy
```
